subject: Apps grays out when importing data from file / works fine locally

messages.author: 4ab057d4fa3b4d75
messages.subject: Apps grays out when importing data from file / works fine locally
parts:
Dear all,

Situation:
  • I have developed a Shiny application that works perfectly locally (https://github.com/kevinrue/TVTB/tree/shinyapps ; requires several Bioconductor packages).
  • When I deploy it to Shiny Apps (https://kevinrue.shinyapps.io/tSVE/), the app works in every way but one: when the action button is clicked to parse a file and import the data, the application greys out and I am "disconnected from server"
    • If you are testing the app, this is in the "Input" > "Variants" tab panel, clicking the "Import variants" button
  • There is no error in the logs (attached)
I have a feeling my problem could be related to the advanced settings for scaling and performance, but the wording of the documentation confuses me a little (especially the worker and instance loads expressed in percentages). Also, for some reason, I have issues changing those advanced settings to (I believe) valid values on a free plan:
  • I cannot seem to increase Max Worker Processes above 1: I get "Error updating settings" when I try to save changes.
    • If the default was "3" (https://www.rstudio.com/products/shinyapps-io-performance-tuning/), I don't know how to restore it.
  • All the other parameters are default (50 connections, 5% worker load factor, ..)

I really have no idea how to work around this issue at this stage.
I welcome any request for additional information.


My problem may be somewhat similar to that described at https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps/issues/190 , except for the "image upload" part which does not concern my app. However, I also get the "Connection closed. Info: {"type":"close","code":1000,"reason":"Normal closure","wasClean":true}" message in the browser console.

All the best,
Kevin

2016-09-08T13:03:52.830915348Z 2016/09/08 13:03:52 Error reading from Shiny: websocket: close 1006 (abnormal closure): unexpected EOF
2016-09-08T13:03:52.830954559Z 2016/09/08 13:03:52 [worker f2554ac7; process 53] Exited with code: 137 (signal 9)
2016-09-08T13:03:52.831269517Z 2016/09/08 13:03:52 [app: 0; bundle: 0] WorkerRetire {workerId:f2554ac7}

Something is causing Shiny itself to give up and close. Cross-posting to the shiny-discuss list in case someone there has any ideas.

With respect to Max Worker Processes, the default is 1 for the Free and Starter plans on shinyapps.io. http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html#worker-settings

messages.subject: Re: Apps grays out when importing data from file / works fine locally
parts:
A little more coffee and a hint from a coworker, and it looks like your application is running out of memory.

You could either rework it to be more memory efficient, or switch to a paid plan that gives your larger instance types with more memory.
